sourceReviewNotes: All 12 paper pages, 24 scheme pages and 51 generated source figures visually read. All 51 first-occurrence Cambria Math glyphs and both Symbol omega glyphs checked against rendered source; graph point markers retained visually.

108 separately practicable tasks; 41/41 census leaves covered. Raw ask scan: 113 lines; the wind-chime narrative condition and cited article title are retained as context rather than treated as separate tasks.
The official scheme was obtained from https://www.examinations.ie/archive/markingschemes/2013/LC021ALP000EV.pdf with HTTP 200; source bytes and hashes are recorded in the sitting audit.
Every Q5 part and both Q5(j) options, both complete 56-mark Q10 options, all eight 7-mark seismometer tasks and every 28-mark Q12 option retained. No choice-combination expansion.

All five forces and positions, metre-stick weight and off-centre centre of gravity; all six Boyle-law pairs, four mirror-distance pairs and six current–voltage pairs retained. The two moment totals share method marks and remain one 15-mark task.

Concave-mirror calculation and graph each retain their full 15-mark route; resistance, resonance apparatus, induction, pendulum stopping and thermocouple methods retain separate routes with the correct single-task total.

ISS photograph, orbital period, altitude, constants and stated orbital acceleration are retained on every relevant task. Printed rounding inconsistencies for linear speed and pendulum stopping force are explicitly explained using the unrounded calculation.

Fractions, powers, nuclear equations, reciprocal graphs and all required diagrams use inspected original source figures. Crop review repaired clipped accelerator edges, equation superscripts, partial prompts and deductions before publication.

Historical simplifications are visibly explained: beta-minus decay also emits an electron antineutrino; neutrons have magnetic moments; signed SHM acceleration has a minus sign; the lowest wind-chime frequency is the fundamental rather than an overtone. Primary clarification sources: https://www.energy.gov/science/doe-explainsbeta-decay and https://www.nist.gov/ncnr/about-ncnr/how-neutrons-are-useful.

The build initially rejected the induction-coil application because its source line begins “any correct answer”. The selector now retains both substantive printed examples with the open acceptance rule in guidance. All 108 drafted tasks ship, with zero drops.

All 3008 prior authored records, 1525 prior Higher runtime blocks, the complete Ordinary runtime file, 582 prior figures and 26 prior review audits are unchanged. All 279 other subject deck/authored files remain byte-identical. Original reference topics and additional old-course headings are retained in the Atlas union.
